items.title: 5.6.1 Factors affecting viscosity (viscosity par asar karne wale factors) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.6.1, printed pages 104-105, with Quick Check 5.5 and answers.

blocks.text: Viscosity par asar karne wale factors yeh hain:

items: Temperature barhane se molecules ki average kinetic energy barhti hai. Is energy se molecules attractive forces (kashish) par qaboo pa lete hain, is liye viscosity kam ho jati hai. (Garam shehad thande shehad se tez behta hai.)
Intermolecular forces jitni mazboot, liquid ki viscosity utni zyada, kyunke molecules ek doosre ke paas se azadi se nahi guzar sakte aur flow mein resistance (rukawat) barh jati hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Acetone (CH₃COCH₃), ethanol (C₂H₅OH) aur dimethyl ether (CH₃OCH₃) ko surface tension ke increasing order (barhti tarteeb) mein likhein, wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Surface tension intermolecular forces ke saath barhti hai. Dimethyl ether (CH₃OCH₃) mein koi O−H nahi aur sirf kamzor dipole-dipole aur London forces hain, is liye us ki surface tension sab se kam hai. Ethanol O−H ki wajah se hydrogen bonds banata hai, aur acetone ka C=O bohat polar hai. Table 5.3 ke mutabiq ethanol 22.75 aur acetone 23.70 (× 10⁻³ N m⁻¹) hain, yani dono qareeb hain aur acetone thora zyada. Order (Table 5.3 ke mutabiq): CH₃OCH₃ < C₂H₅OH < CH₃COCH₃.

blocks.prompt: b) CCl₄ ki viscosity CHCl₃ se zyada magar ethanol se kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: CCl₄ CHCl₃ se bhari aur bara molecule hai, is liye us ki London forces zyada hain aur woh aahista behta hai. Ethanol hydrogen bonds banata hai jo in dono ki forces se mazboot hain, is liye ethanol sab se zyada viscous hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Zyada viscosity wali dawaiyan (drugs) asani se oxidize kyun nahi hotin?
blocks.explanation: Viscous (gaarhe) liquid mein molecules aahista harkat karte hain, is liye hawa ki oxygen andar tak aahista diffuse hoti (phailti) hai aur dawa ke molecules se kam takrati hai. Is liye oxidation ka rate kam rehti hai aur dawa der tak theek rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Shehad (honey) ki viscosity pani se zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Shehad sugar (shakar) ka bohat gaarha solution hai. Sugar ke bare molecules par bohat se O−H groups hain jo aapas mein aur pani se bohat se hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye shehad flow mein bohat zyada resistance karta hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Glycerine aur hexane mein kaun zyada viscous hai? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Glycerine. Us ke har molecule mein teen O−H groups hain jo bohat se hydrogen bonds banate hain, jabke hexane mein sirf kamzor London forces hain. (Kitab ne formulas ghalat chhape hain; sahi: glycerine CH₂OHCHOHCH₂OH, hexane C₆H₁₄.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Quick Check 5.5 (e) mein kitab glycerine ko “CH₂OHCH₂OHCH₂OH” aur hexane ko “C₆H₆” likhti hai. Sahi formulas: glycerine CH₂OHCHOHCH₂OH (beech wale carbon par ek hi H hota hai) aur hexane C₆H₁₄ (C₆H₆ benzene hai).

items: Temperature barhe to viscosity kam (zyada kinetic energy); intermolecular forces mazboot hon to viscosity zyada (glycerine, shehad, pani hydrogen bonds ki wajah se gaarhe; hexane patla).
